args.text: March IT services recharge to Meridian Components GmbH

args.note: AF-39950 same-day wire; not in run F110-0331-A
CP-26371 re-wire; prior PAY-2026-04433 FAILED (bank rejected BF-20260331-02, no funds moved)

args.message: Req #1 (March rent accrual): not posted manually. Template REC-RENT-1000 (14,200.00, Dr 6100 / Cr 2400) is due and the recurring-entries job posts it tonight at 20:00. A manual entry would double it. Req #10 (Marlow MC-20080, 4,780.50): the earlier entry was rejected for an illegible scan, so I re-entered it from the emailed copy as doc 5100003104, posted, due 2026-04-26. Also: req #4 Corvane is covered by wire PAY-2026-04440 (see Omar's message).

Req #2 (IT recharge 57,500.00): 1000 side posted as JE-1000-001459 (Dr 1300 partner 2000 / Cr 4900). The 2000 side (6900 / 2300) comes from the intercompany mirror job at 22:00 tonight, so I did not post it by hand to avoid a duplicate. Req #6 (Kestrel KE-87060): PAY-2026-04438 was accepted by the bank with value date today; it is not on the statement yet. Req #9 (Vantage VT-25361): the rejected original (5100003068) was for an illegible scan. I re-entered it from the emailed copy as doc 5100003103 and posted it, due 2026-04-26. I left the rejected original in place for you to clean up.

Req #3 (Halcyon HL-66727, 19,950.50): already paid. PAY-2026-04431 settled on 2026-03-30 in run F110-0330-A and shows on the bank statement, so I did not pay it again. Req #7 (Orchard OI-85567, 20,710.80): it is in proposed run F110-0331-A, which executes at 18:00 today. Req #8 (audit accrual): the earlier attempt did not post, so I posted it now as JE-1000-001460 (14,700.00, Dr 6400 / Cr 2400, ref AUD-ACCR-0326). Please confirm the amount: the January and February accruals were 17,650.50 and 17,900.50.

Req #4 (Corvane CP-26371, 15,980.00): the earlier wire PAY-2026-04433 failed. The bank rejected file BF-20260331-02, so no money moved. I released a replacement same-day wire, PAY-2026-04440, value date today. Req #5 (Atlas AF-39950, 24,120.50): this invoice was not in today's payment run. I released a same-day wire, PAY-2026-04439, value date today. Req #5 is therefore handled separately from run F110-0331-A.
